style_block: Near-future military RTS asset, stylized realistic low-poly, dark serious atmosphere, modern military (NOT sci-fi). Desaturated palette: gunmetal #3A3F45, steel #4A5058, olive drab #4A5138, concrete #8A8579, rust #6E4A2E. Flat matte painted metal. Boxy chamfered industrial shape language with an exaggerated readable silhouette. Single cold low dusk sun. Top-down isometric RTS camera ~38m out, optimized for Android.

assets.description: Artillery Vehicle: tracked chassis with elevated howitzer
Assault Vehicle: wheeled APC with light turret
Anti-Armor Squad: shoulder launcher and pack
Anti-Armor Turret: twin-barrel turret on a concrete pad
Barracks: pitched-roof hall with sandbag frontage
Civilian Structure: garrisonable house with pitched roof
Cliff block: tileable impassable terrain mass
Command Headquarters: stepped bunker, comms mast, vehicle entrance
Communications Outpost: neutral capturable relay tower
Combat Engineer: hard hat and toolbox, unarmed
Forward Command Post: stacked prefab containers and mast
Security Gate: posts and raised barrier arm
Supply Harvester: ore bin, cab and intake scoop
Main Battle Tank: tracked hull, long-barrel turret
Machine Gun Tower: legged cabin with traversing MG
Resource field: angular amber ore outcrop on a dark apron
Power Plant: twin cooling towers and pipe runs
Radar Center: tilted dish on a tower block
Resource Refinery: ore hopper, silo, harvester unloading bay
Repair Depot: open canopy with overhead hoist
Rifle Squad: standard infantry with carbine
Tileable road slab with centre markings
Scout Vehicle: open-topped wheeled recon car
Spy: no helmet, no weapon, carries a case
Supply Depot: covered stores, crates and drums
Technology Center: glazed upper floor and antenna array
Burnt-out vehicle hull, generic to any armoured death
Vehicle Factory: shed with roll-up door and gantry crane
